record.summary: Adopts the migration file-name contract, the set it builds, and the six fixtures that exist to test it. Closes F-052 by making the two disabled fixture cases executable at the layer that actually rejects them, which is where #[should_panic] works and where the cluster test could not reach. Records three findings, one of them executed: the panic a malformed name produces names the wrong rule. Repairs no runtime behavior.
